page.notes: The Hebrew strip is cut off at the left edge and most lines are only fragments; the dots mark places where the letters are not clear enough to copy, so the readings above are partial and need checking against the full page. The first Hebrew line and the right-hand letters of several lines are doubtful. The Latin lines at the foot are a fragment that continues on the missing part of the page. A small mark near the foot is not text. Catchword and signature read from the foot of the column; the scan is faint in places, and the word "mascult" is printed as such and is uncertain [?]. Text ends mid-sentence at the cut.
